$comment: Channel 0.2 return-channel census. Producers and consumers are discovered from each gate's syntax tree and nothing here lists them; this file holds only the exemptions and the accumulator kinds, each anchored on the text it exempts so it fails when that text moves. build/verify-channel-0.2-return-channels.ps1 states the units and their limits.

producerExemptions.reason: It hands back a generated VECTOR, not a gate-internal record, and its consumers are the twenty-six evaluators, which read it by dynamic field path -- `Get-Field $Vector 'observations.unseenRefusals'`, `Read-Required`, `$Vector.PSObject.Properties['...']` -- through a parameter named `$Vector` rather than through the variable this census follows. A member census over the assigned variable therefore measures nothing here and would report every field of a conforming vector as unread. The question it looks like it is asking -- which declared vector field does no property read -- is AX2's unit, and it is answered by the reconciliation the vector index performs before any property runs.

accumulators.name: UnpublishedFields
accumulators.reason: `Read-Required` adds to it the fields one evaluation read and its vector does not publish, and AU2's rule is that such a verdict is evidence of neither conformance nor violation. It is therefore about the evaluation that just ran and must be cleared before each top-level dispatch and drained after it.

accumulators.name: OptionalReads
accumulators.reason: It records, over the WHOLE declared run, the declared verdicts of the inputs that left each declared-optional field absent. The check at the end asks which declaration no input exercised and which none of the inputs that exercised it is declared green on, exactly as ObligationsReached's does for obligations, so a clear anywhere would make an unexercised declaration indistinguishable from one exercised before the clear.

accumulators.name: ObligationReads
accumulators.reason: BC1. The mirror of OptionalReads, over the same whole run and for the same reason: it records the declared verdicts of the inputs that left each declared-obligation field absent, and the check at the end asks which declaration no input the property is declared RED on exercised. A clear anywhere would make an obligation no mutation reaches indistinguishable from one reached before the clear.

accumulators.name: DeclarationCitations
accumulators.reason: BD. Keyed exactly as OptionalReads and ObligationReads are, it records the artifact and the words each meaning-carrying declaration cites, and the check at the end reads a declaration's polarities and its citation off the same key. A citation does not change between inputs, and the check asks about every declaration the run made, so a clear anywhere would leave a declaration with polarities and no citation to check them against.

accumulators.name: ObligationsReached
accumulators.reason: `New-Red` records the call site of every obligation any input reaches, and AU1's check asks at the end of the run which obligation no declared input reached. That question is over the whole run, so a clear anywhere would make an unreached obligation indistinguishable from one reached before the clear.
